_comment: Automation buildings. They work anywhere and sell what they clean at once. Every machine upgrades Mk I-V (x1.8 output per tier). radius: collector circle (m). rate: m2 per second a hexagon machine clears at Mk I. deep_rate: collector dust per second.

machines.name: Dust Collector
machines.desc: Keeps a circle of ground around itself clean and extracts deep regolith forever. Sells everything automatically.

machines.name: Hexagon Cleaning Station
machines.desc: Clears the whole hexagon it stands in, then moves on to the nearest unfinished hexagon by itself. Mk I takes about 10 minutes per hexagon, Mk V about one.

machines.name: Drone Hangar
machines.desc: A drone squad that clears any hexagon on the Moon. Tap the hangar, then CHOOSE ON MAP - or let it pick the nearest unfinished one.
